# generate_video_tool

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

START generating a short video clip (4–12 s, with audio on Veo) from a text prompt,
optionally animating a still image you pass as `reference_llm_file_id` (its first
frame / subject — the reliable way to get exact copy and logo into a video: make
the still with brand_composition or generate_image_tool first, then animate it).

This call RETURNS IMMEDIATELY with a `request_id` — the render takes 1–5 minutes.
Then call wait_for_tool with condition_type "video_generation_completed" and
condition_params { request_id } and END YOUR TURN; you are re-invoked with the
finished file's link (the clip is also attached to your last post). Never poll
or re-call this tool for the same clip — every call is a new, billed render.

COST: video is priced PER SECOND (roughly 5–70¢/s depending on model and
resolution; the response tells you the estimate). Confirm duration and
resolution with the requester before generating anything over 8 s or 1080p.

PROMPTING: one scene, one camera move, lighting, mood, what stays still. Put any
on-screen copy in quotes but prefer a reference still for exact text. `style:
"brand"` (default) prepends the workspace brand notes.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string | yes | Scene, camera move, lighting, mood. One idea per clip. |
| `duration_seconds` | string | no | Clip length in seconds (default "8"). Veo: 4/6/8, Sora: 4/8/12 — clamped per provider. One of: `4`, `6`, `8`, `12`. |
| `aspect_ratio` | string | no | 16:9 (default) or 9:16 (stories / reels). One of: `16:9`, `9:16`. |
| `resolution` | string | no | 720p (default, cheapest) or 1080p. One of: `720p`, `1080p`. |
| `reference_llm_file_id` | integer | no | An image LlmFile to animate (first frame / subject). |
| `negative_prompt` | string | no | What to avoid (Veo only). |
| `style` | string | no | "brand" (default) prepends the workspace brand palette/style notes. One of: `brand`, `free`. |
| `provider` | string | no | Pin a provider (default: configured order). One of: `google`, `openai`. |
| `title` | string | no | Title for the saved file (default: derived from the prompt). |
| `directory_path` | string | no | Virtual folder for the file (default "/skills/videos"). |
